note: Hand-built game_context.json-shaped fixture for the `divisional` family (scripts/signals/divisional.py). Six 2024 rows covering every branch the family has: a divisional first meeting, its in-season rematch, a non-divisional game, a non-divisional rematch (which must NOT take the rematch term), a divisional playoff third meeting (which must also NOT take it), and a row with a null meeting_no. NOT generated from nflverse - the div_game/meeting_no values are asserted by hand in tests, so a fixture regenerated from the producer would grade the producer with its own marking scheme. Carries no market column and never will.
